title: Vitalpinum Wohlfühlpark Thal-Assling
highlights: Einzigartiger alpiner Wohlfuehl- und Duftpark auf ueber 5000 Quadratmetern im Pustertal
Schau-Latschendestillerie zur Gewinnung von aetherischem Latschenkiefernoel
Grosses Kneippbecken, Barfusspfad und duftende Kraeuter-Ruheinseln
Heubad-Inhalation und Klangschalen-Pavillon mit Blick auf die Lienzer Dolomiten
kurzbeschreibung: Vitalpinum in Thal-Assling is an alpine sensory garden focusing on medicinal herbs, mountain pine oil distillation, Kneipp wellness, and relaxation.
beschreibung:
The Power of Alpine Herbs

The Vitalpinum in Thal near Assling is an idyllic adventure park that invigorates all the senses. Surrounded by the steep limestone peaks of the Lienzer Dolomiten, this wellness garden centers on the healing effects of alpine plants and essential oils.

Scented Garden, Show Distillery, and Kneipp Facilities

In the historic show distillery, visitors can witness how precious healing oil is extracted from fresh mountain pine needles. Wellness stations such as the pine Kneipp pool, barefoot path, and herbal pavilion invite guests to breathe deeply and unwind.
